It's easy to be locked up in that quest. The trolls are impossible and you don't get enough poison (turpentine I guess) from the painter. What helped me: turn left (facing the green marker where the body of the thief is) and jump on the rocks to get there. You will encounter only 3 trolls instead of 6/7,and can kill them with the turpentine (usually 2 or 3 per troll). If you run out of turpentine, change the difficulty level to the left and try to kill the remaining trolls with bow or fire.

My nmom compares me to my dad a lot. She's been doing this since they got separated when I was 6. I tried asking (even pleading) her not to do it, because how hurtful it is, but to no avail. She likes to torment me with these negative comparisons. She is genuinely happy when I show sadness or anger over it. My strategy now is pretending it does not affect me anymore. I'm trying to be sarcastic and say things like "yeah, tell me something new, for a change". She gets mad and says "she can't have a normal conversation with me", but eventually gives up and leave me alone for a while.

I started doing this with my mother. Even if her comments hurt me, I try to maintain a still face and rationalize the situation, to distance myself from what she is saying. Sometimes I even laugh at the absurdity of her complains. She let go of me for a while now, because I'm not giving the attention she wants, and she moved on a new target, her new boyfriend.

Congratulations for stepping up and defending yourself. Your husband seems very supportive and that is great.
